achievements.name: Opening Course
achievements.detail: Clear the first course of Pipe-Rock Plateau.

achievements.name: Wonder Flower
achievements.detail: Touch a Wonder Flower and get through the change it makes to the course.

achievements.name: Wonder Seed
achievements.detail: Complete a course and take the Wonder Seed from its goal.

achievements.name: Flower Coins
achievements.detail: Collect all three 10-flower coins in one course.

achievements.name: Badge Equipped
achievements.detail: Buy a badge from a Poplin and equip it for a course.

achievements.name: Wonder Form
achievements.detail: Trigger a Wonder effect that turns you into an elephant, a drill, or a bubble.

achievements.name: Extra Seed
achievements.detail: Earn a course's extra Wonder Seed beyond the one for simply finishing it.

achievements.name: Standee
achievements.detail: Place a standee of your character inside a course.

achievements.name: Pipe-Rock Plateau
achievements.detail: Finish Pipe-Rock Plateau and continue to the next world.

achievements.name: Last Castle
achievements.detail: Clear the castle that ends the main adventure.
